# Hadcor Craft

**⚠️ ATTENTION!** For the Hadcor Craft mod to work, you must install the Fabric API! Without it, the mod will not start.

### Download link Fabric API 0.116.7:
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.116.7+1.21.1)

![Hadcor Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9361bd8e8b614fed8ba5b9e756880dcb150e02a1.png)

This mod is only for Fabric version 1.21.1. Currently, the version is Alpha 1.0.0.

* **Minecraft version:** 1.21.1
* **Mod version:** Alpha 1.0.0

Hadcor Craft - you won't get boards from wood here. To craft boards, you need an axe and wood. You will get 18 sticks from one log, and from 4 sticks you will get 1 board.
